display.purpose: The School's name in the report head only; 1.375rem below 52rem.

body.purpose: Running text, inputs, buttons, record cells; 68ch measure.

label.purpose: Form labels, column heads, fact terms, tabs, the key, state words, quiet and stamp buttons.

small.purpose: Role labels; stacked field names on phone records.

figures.purpose: Identifiers and codes in Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono; records use tabular-nums.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Every colour, border and background transition.

motion.name: seal-slide
motion.purpose: View transition moving the seal edge to the new tab; the page swaps in place without a fade.

motion.name: holding
motion.purpose: Loading placeholder in the shape of a record.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; the seal slide is skipped.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: The one breakpoint: tabs to a three-column grid, key below record, records stacked into entries.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 20px; background: var(--seal); border: 1px solid var(--seal); border-radius: var(--corner); color: var(--on-seal); font: inherit; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 90ms ease-out; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--seal-strong); border-color: var(--seal-strong); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--seal); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The second action beside a first: outlined, not filled.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 20px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--corner); color: var(--seal); font: inherit; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--wash-seal); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--seal) 55%, transparent); color: var(--seal-strong); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--seal); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Head actions such as Sign out, and pager steps.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 14px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--corner); color: var(--ink); font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--wash-seal); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--seal) 55%, transparent); color: var(--seal-strong); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--seal); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stamp Button
components.description: An action that takes something away: alarm as text and outline, never a fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 14px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--alarm) 55%, transparent); border-radius: var(--corner); color: var(--alarm); font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-stamp:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--alarm) 10%, transparent); border-color: var(--alarm); } .ds-btn-stamp:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--alarm); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Held Button
components.description: Disabled: dashed outline and softened words, never mistaken for a quiet button.
components.css: .ds-btn-held { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 20px; background: transparent; border: 1px dashed var(--rule); border-radius: var(--corner); color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink-soft) 80%, transparent); font: inherit; font-weight: 650; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above, field-ground well, seal border on focus.
components.css: .ds-label { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; color: var(--ink); } .ds-input { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 9px 12px; background: var(--field); border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--corner); color: var(--ink); font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-input:hover:not(:focus) { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 40%, transparent); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--seal); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--seal); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Section Tabs
components.description: Report-page tabs in the band; the current one lifted onto the page under the single seal edge.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-nav { padding: 0 16px; background: var(--band); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-nav ul { display: flex; gap: 2px; margin: 0 0 -1px; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-bottom: 0; border-radius: var(--corner) var(--corner) 0 0; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:not([aria-current]):hover { background: var(--wash); color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { background: var(--page); border-color: var(--rule); color: var(--ink); } .ds-seal { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 3px; border-radius: var(--corner) var(--corner) 0 0; background: var(--seal); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--seal); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: School Switcher
components.description: The other Schools, opened under the button that offers them.
components.html:
Switch School

components.css: .ds-switcher { position: relative; display: inline-block; } .ds-switcher summary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 14px; background: var(--field); border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--corner); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; list-style: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switcher summary::after { content: ''; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-right: 2px solid currentColor; border-bottom: 2px solid currentColor; transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(45deg); } .ds-switcher[open] summary::after { transform: translateY(2px) rotate(-135deg); } .ds-switcher summary:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 40%, transparent); } .ds-switcher ul { margin: 6px 0 0; padding: 4px 0; min-width: 14rem; background: var(--field); border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--corner); list-style: none; } .ds-switcher li a { display: block; padding: 8px 16px; color: var(--seal); text-decoration: none; } .ds-switcher li a:hover { background: var(--wash-seal); } .ds-switcher li:last-child { margin-top: 4px; padding-top: 4px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule-faint); }

components.name: State Marks
components.description: State as a word with a disc: filled, ringed, struck. Never colour alone.
components.html: May read Unclaimed May not read
components.css: .ds-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-right: 16px; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-mark::before { content: ''; width: 0.625rem; height: 0.625rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 50%; } .ds-mark--filled, .ds-mark--open { color: var(--seal); } .ds-mark--filled::before { background: var(--seal); border-color: var(--seal); } .ds-mark--open::before { border: 2px solid var(--seal); } .ds-mark--struck::before { border-color: var(--ink-soft); background: linear-gradient(135deg, transparent calc(50% - 0.75px), var(--ink-soft) calc(50% - 0.75px) calc(50% + 0.75px), transparent calc(50% + 0.75px)); }

components.name: Record
components.description: A ruled table in tabular figures; soft-ink heads over a rule, faint rules between rows.
components.css: .ds-record { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; text-align: left; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink); } .ds-record th { padding: 0 12px 8px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-record td { padding: 12px 12px 12px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-faint); transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-record tbody tr:hover { background: var(--wash); } .ds-id { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: var(--ink-soft); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; }

components.description: An issued record or the one modal overlay: field ground, rule border, 3px seal top edge, square corners.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-slip { display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 24px; background: var(--field); border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-top: 3px solid var(--seal); color: var(--ink); } .ds-slip h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-slip p { margin: 0; } .ds-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; } .ds-slip-stamp { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 14px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--alarm) 55%, transparent); border-radius: var(--corner); color: var(--alarm); font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-slip-ghost { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 20px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--corner); color: var(--seal); font: inherit; font-weight: 650; }

narrative.overview:
Every screen reads as an official school record: whom it concerns, who is acting, and what was recorded, in that order. The reading field is calm and nearly colourless, cool near-white in light and deep slate in dark, and a single seal blue marks what can be acted on and what is current. Colour lives in hairline edges and seal marks, never in large fills beyond the one primary button.

The page is a report: a full-width band carries the wordmark, the School's name set as the largest type on the page, "Signed in as" with the roles held, and the section tabs; the current tab is lifted onto the page and wears the seal along its top edge. Below, a narrow key sits at the left edge beside a wide ruled record. Density is comfortable, not cramped: 44px controls, ruled rows at least 56px tall on rosters, and a 68ch reading measure.

The system refuses the portal default (white cards on grey behind a left rail) and any themed costume, including the ditto sheet it replaced. There are two renditions, light and dark, and the browser's own setting picks between them (ADR-0010); there is no manual toggle.
keyCharacteristics: One hyperlegible sans for words, its mono cut for identifiers and codes, tabular figures in records.
One hue (seal blue) for action, current place and state marks; alarm red only for errors and actions that take something away.
State is always a word with a mark beside it: filled, ringed or struck disc.
Ruled, flat surfaces: hairlines and a one-step tonal band, no shadows.
A fixed type scale that does not grow with the window.
Every colour is a token defined for both renditions.

rules.name: The One Seal Rule
rules.body: Seal blue is the only hue in the system. It marks what can be acted on, what is current, and what state a record is in. No second accent, no status greens or ambers.

rules.name: The Alarm Exception Rule
rules.body: Alarm red is sanctioned for two things only: an error, named in words, and an action that takes something away (the stamp button and the confirming button in a removal slip). It is text and outline; it is never a fill and never the only signal.

rules.name: The Two Renditions Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a token defined for both light and dark. A rule that names a raw colour breaks one of the renditions.

rules.name: The Fixed Ramp Rule
rules.body: One fixed scale (0.8125, 0.875, 1, 1.125, 1.375, 1.75, 2rem). A product's type does not grow with the window; the only responsive change is the School's name stepping down on a phone.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: One sans for all words, bold for emphasis, its mono cut for figures. No second display face, no uppercase tracking labels.

rules.name: The Ruled, Not Raised Rule
rules.body: Separate things with hairlines and the band's one tonal step, never with shadow or a floating card in the reading plane.

dos: Do name every colour through a token that has both a light and a dark value.
Do pair every state with a word and a filled, ringed or struck seal disc; the mark is never the only difference.
Do keep seal blue for action, the current place, links, focus and marks, and nothing else.
Do confine alarm red to errors and to actions that take something away, as text and outline.
Do separate with 1px hairlines (`rule` for sections, `rule-faint` between rows) and the band's one tonal step.
Do set identifiers in Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono and keep records in tabular figures.
Do keep controls at least 44px tall (40px for quiet and switcher), with the 3px seal focus outline.
Do draw a held control with a dashed rule border and softened words.
Do let things settle in 200ms on cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), and honour reduced motion by dropping transitions and the seal slide.
donts: Don't use shadows, or float cards in the reading plane; the switcher list and the slip dialog are the only things over the page.
Don't fill a control with alarm red, or use colour alone to carry state.
Don't introduce a second accent hue or status colours (green, amber).
Don't round role labels or tags into pills; they keep a 2px corner.
Don't scale type with the viewport.
Don't add a second typeface, uppercase tracked labels, or icon-font glyphs; draw small marks from borders.
Don't put more than one seal edge in the tab row.
Don't reach for an inline style; the Content Security Policy forbids it and the build fails on it.
